verdict.rationale: Simular's own docs name an official Python SDK (`pip install sai-sdk`) and a JS library (`simulang-js`). Both sit on top of a documented Sai REST API (message, event-stream and approve endpoints) and an official `@simular-ai/sai-mcp` package. Missing for 10: SDK reference depth beyond install lines, a published OpenAPI spec (all probed paths 404), multi-language coverage beyond Python and JS, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
